notes.title: ROVA DEMO | V0.3.0 Release | Easter Update
notes.content:
[h2]V0.3.0 Release[/h2]

Hey all - Tom here! 

We've been a little quiet on socials recently, but don't worry - we've had our heads down working hard to make ROVA the best it can be.

This Update marks a pretty significant milestone in development. 
Most 'backend' systems are now finished, meaning we can soon fully focus on actual game content and building more fleshed-out planets - I'm very excited to get working on the next stage of development.

Before I ramble about what's in V0.3.0 I'd like to announce we'll be taking part in the 'Minimal and Chill Showcase', alongside a bunch of other great games. Massive shoutout to Unikat for organising the event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971668/cb3bd3fc0db3ab6fe4333aea039d61b9dfd0aa47.png[/img]

[h3]Easter Content[/h3]

With the event coinciding with Easter here in the UK, we thought it would be fun to include an Easter Egg hunt. You can access this special quest by speaking to one of the colonists.

Don't worry, we've added optional bunny ears and tails for the colonists too.


[h3]Colonist Customisation[/h3]

After putting the colonists in fancy dress for the Halloween and Christmas updates, it didn't take long to realise that we needed to add the option to customise colonists.

Well.. Now you can!

You can access this feature at the terminal, by clicking 'Colonist Dress Up'.

We've also included a completely new Living Quarters for the colonists, with a bit more personality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971668/7395d6d453e4c625a8c82e20f2be00c926d163c6.gif[/img]

[h3]Saving + Loading[/h3]

Need to stop playing the demo? No problem, you can now save your progress.

I appreciate how frustrating not being able to save the game was for some of you, and for that I apologise. 

I can't promise saves will be fully compatible with all future updates, but we'll try our best to ensure they do.

Once the game is fully released, we plan to keep a demo out with saves that carry on into the full game (but this is future stuff).


[h3]Better Quest Systems + Dialogue[/h3]

As mentioned, we've put a LOT of work into the game systems and the tools we have to make more content. 

Quest systems have been completely re-made in a way which will allow us to quickly make more content. It's a win for everyone.

Currently, the main quests in this update are similar to previous versions of the demo.
We have included an additional 'Easter Egg Hunt' quest which can be found by speaking to one of the colonists.

This brings me to our next point - we finally have dialogue systems! 
You can now speak to all of the colonists and they even have cute gibberish voices.

On the surface these new systems might not seem much different as you play, but you'll certainly see an increase in content from this point on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971668/d4bc0027dc81b13479f7fe80ff76d94d7d41e862.png[/img]



[h2]Community Feedback[/h2]

As always, community feedback has played a really important role in ROVA's development. Your support means the world to us🪐

If you do have any future feedback, the best place to share it is in the steam community forums.

Feel free to share your ingame photos with any of our socials - We'd love to see what you discover!


[h2][h1]Changelog[/h1][/h2]

Easter Content:

[+] Added an Easter Egg hunt quest (speak to one of the colonists to collect)

[+] Costumes for colonists


Colonist Customisation:

[+] Added a bunch of Costumes for colonists

[+] New Living area building added


Colonist AI:

[+] Added InDialogue state to colonists, so you can talk to them


Saving and Loading:

[+] Added load game button to the main menu

[+] Game now saves at regular intervals and when quitting to main menu


UI Changes:

[+] Added load button to main menu

[+] Added 'saving' popup when the game is saving

[+] Quests are now displayed in the Quests section in the pause menu

[-] Removed quest info from HUD (as it's now shown in its own section)

[+] Various Icon improvement

[+] Notification popups for quests pending upload and quests received

[+] Added virtual keyboard for use with controller


Rover:

[+] Reworked rover movement again, so that it doesn't climb walls and feels nicer to control


Additional Changes:

[+] Lots of back-end changes ready for the next update (we promise they're there!)
 
[+] Collision fixes

[+] Various bug fixes

notes.title: ROVA DEMO | V0.2.0 Release | Winter Festivities Update
notes.content:
[h2]V0.2.0 Release[/h2]

Hey all - Tom here! 

I'll be honest, this update took far longer to release than we expected... But it's an exciting one!

We've reworked the rover physics controls, added the fancy new 'Research Database', created more seasonal event content to replace the previous Halloween content and done a fair amount more.


Let's jump right in to it:


[h3]Winter Festivities Content[/h3]

With the success of the previous Halloween Update, we had to do something to bring in the Winter Festivities. 

Expect some cool vibes around the colony, with a chance of snow.

Our 3D artist, Leiona, has once again been the main driving force behind this festive visual content. Expect to see a range of festive scenes dotted around the planet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971668/911f07dbd93bd46ff865fb88cf87104b1d2bb79e.png[/img]

Note: This seasonal content is only available for a limited time and will be removed in a later update. 


[h3]Audio Effects[/h3]

This is by no means complete, but we have begun the process of adding audio effects to ROVA's world.
Expect to hear a few ambient sounds and bumps as you crash into the wilderness.

We'll be drastically expanding these soundscapes in future updates.


[h3]Reworked Rover Controls and New Model[/h3]

Some players didn't like how 'skiddy' the rover felt, and I had to agree.
Fixing this issue became quite a journey, which resulted in me completely re-writing how the rover moves.

The new movement system is more 'physics driven', with dynamic bouncy suspension. 
It really emphasises turning, and I think it looks pretty cool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971668/85cb993754a79790bb6c242be842f5038edc2788.png[/img]

You'll also notice our lil' rover has had a few visual upgrades, thanks to the [b]new Rover model[/b] created by our lead 3D artist, Jack.

This new model made it much easier to add some additional animations, such as movement on the propeller whilst underwater, alongside a bunch of small and cute head movements. We have a lot of animation work planned for the future, so this is only the beginning.

Overall, this is a drastic, but hopefully welcome change.

We still imagine we'll need to do some fine-tuning to the controls, following player feedback. Please let us know what you think - it's a massive help!


[h3]Research Database[/h3]

This update marks a pivotal moment in ROVA's development - the inclusion of the Research Database.

Previously, objects around the planet had simple names to aid photography quests, but that was about it. It didn't really feel like making 'discoveries'.

We've addressed that.

Everything.. literally [b]everything[/b] on the planet is part of a database, that you can slowly expand as you make new discoveries. 

Want to know what something is? Take a photo, upload it to the Research Terminal and [b]BOOM[/b], you've got a new data entry.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971668/d653a1234fe06894ec24160201ed6da92af4baa6.png[/img]

All photos you take are added to the database, ready for you to browse at your leisure. You can even favourite the ones you like best, and view them in the favourites section! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971668/845d037746f1ec1a6f3093099d171c5d74bf950d.png[/img]

But that isn't all.. You can also download your photos to your PC! 
*Note: This used to happen automatically and got annoying fast. Choice is important! 

It's still early days for the database... We have [b]massive[/b] plans to expand it in some not-too-distant future updates. It truly is the foundation we'll build upon for the next evolution of ROVA.

Ethan took charge of making this system and it's been a heck of a job. I can't thank him enough for his help.



[h2]Changelog[/h2]

Controller Support:

[+] We officially now have [b]Full Controller support[/b] for Xbox and Playstation controllers
[+] Better support for other types of controllers
[+] Added controller disconnect popup

Input Settings:

[+] Added Invert-Y look option to settings menu
[+] Invert-Y Setting should save and be remembered when re-opening the game

UI Changes:

[+] UI navigation improvements
[+] Integrated new Database and photo-browser with the Pause Menu
[+] Removed menu elements from the Research Terminal UI, that are part of the database
[+] Added a range menu transitions and animations
[+] Removed photo settings menu (can now save out pics from database instead)

Winter Festive Content (limited time event content):

[+] Added various winter themed props 
[+] Added 'snow' around the colony base
[+] Costumes for colonists
[+] Colonists now leave 'snowy' footprints
[+] Lighting changes around the colony base 
[+] Additional Festive changes to the colony when completing the 'Find tree-like Flora' quest.

Research Database:

[+] Added all world objects to the Research Database
[+] All photos are saved to a save file, instead of as jpgs on player PC's
     *Note: save files are [b]overwritten[/b] upon each [b]new game[/b]. Load functionality will be added to a later update.
[+] Player photos can now be viewed in the Database menu
[+] Player photos can now be saved to PC as .jpg images, from the Database menu

Environment:

[+] Added lighting overrides to Caves, which dynamically changes light colour, fog colour and fog density
[+] Various asset placement fixes
[+] Various collider fixes
[+] Added enter and exit effects to water

Player Rover:

[+] New rover model
[+] New physics-based movement system
[+] Revised camera system to work with new movement system
[+] Various idle and movement animations
[+] Various bug fixes

Audio:

[+] Added ambient audio whilst driving around
[+] Added ambient audio underwater
[+] Water enter / exit sound effects
[+] Collision effects added to a range of objects
[+] Balance pass on all volume (music is now slightly quieter overall)

Additional Changes:

[+] Disabled photos automatically saving to PC
[+] Lots of back-end changes ready for the next update (we promise they're there!)
[+] Various bug fixes




[h2]Community Feedback[/h2]

Everyone at FreeRangeDevs would like to thank you all once again for your continued support.
Community feedback has always and continues to play a really important role in ROVA's development. 

If you do have any future feedback, the best place to share it is in the steam community forums.

Feel free to share your in game photos with any of our socials - We'd love to see what you discover!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971668/7854921c9ecf3bd8b3ad8a6211dbc743c2567b8a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: ROVA DEMO | V0.1.3 Release | Halloween Update
notes.content:
[h2]V0.1.3 Release[/h2]

Hey all - Tom here! 

We've been a little quiet on socials recently, but don't worry - we're still listening to your feedback and working hard to make ROVA the best it can be.

Two new members recently joined our ranks and they have been a [b]massive[/b] help! Obviously there was a bit of an onboarding process, but they quickly got used to our workflows and have added so much to the project already. I can't thank them enough.


[h3]Halloween Content[/h3]

Being the Halloween Update, expect to see cute costumes and spooky vibes around the colony. Don't worry, nothing scary! 

Our new 3D artist, Leiona, has been the main driving force behind the new Halloween costumes and props you'll see in this update. 

Here's a sneak peak:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971668/438a2d04f958ec10645e45dd0658a965b5ec0d1e.jpg[/img]

I might have made some adjustments to the colonist schedules and added some animations for a party - but you can find that for yourself 😉

You can also find little Halloween scenes dotted around the planet. Can you find them all?

Note: This seasonal content is only available for a limited time and will be removed in a later update. 

[h3]Additional Updates/Changes[/h3]

I've been working closely with our new Unity Game Dev / Programmer, Ethan, on a lot of back-end systems ready for a future large content update. I won't spoil the surprise, so you'll hear more about this in a future post.

Ethan has also put a lot of work into improving UI (and encouraged me to clean up my messy UI code). 
Menu screens are smoother, with nice animated transitions and better feedback. 

He has also updated the main game HUD, with icons that feel more polished than just text.
My hope is the 'Look Home' feature should be more obvious to new players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971668/cb0614be40aace1988e8cb172bca2b023aa67410.png[/img]

ROVA now has better support for alternative aspect ratios, such as 4:3.

Here it is on my CRT monitor:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971668/8baa0e2109d50f59edebde83e00fc7e42af8d8d2.png[/img]


In a future update we'll be addressing how we handle saving photos, aiming to give players more choice / control.

In the meantime I've made a large, yet simple improvement to saved photos. 
Player photos are now saved as jpg instead of png, making the file size 10x smaller, with no loss in quality. 

Note: This change will not impact images saved before this update.


[h2]Community Feedback[/h2]

As always, community feedback has played a really important role in ROVA's development. Your support means the world to us🪐

If you do have any future feedback, the best place to share it is in the steam community forums.

Feel free to share your ingame photos with any of our socials - We'd love to see what you discover!

notes.title: ROVA DEMO | V0.1.2 Release | Aka "The Improved Follow cam Fix" 🪐
notes.content:
Hey all!

Although this is classed as a 'Minor Update', we feel this is still [b]big[/b] news:

[h3]V0.1.2 is now out![/h3]

The main focus for this update has been the Player Follow Camera, but we've also made a few other changes to the world thanks to your feedback. Ultimately this should lead to a smoother experience overall, with the rover feeling easier to control and cetrain locations being easier to navigate. (See Changelog below!)

Today also marks the end of the 'Steam Space Exploration Fest'. It's been a great help sharing the game with you all and we're delighted to say we've surpassed the small wishlist goal we had in mind 🥳

Thanks for helping us pass [b]500 wishlists[/b] - we're well on our way to that first thousand! <3

As always, community feedback has played a really important role in ROVA's development. Your support means the world to us🪐

If you do have any future feedback, the best place to share it is in the steam community forums.

[h2][h1]Changelog[/h1][/h2]

Camera Fixes:

[+] Completely re-wrote the main rover follow camera system

[+] Solved [i]most[/i] camera clipping issues (that's right, you now can't see under the floor!)

[+] Added the option to reset the camera position, by clicking the 'Right Thumbstick' on gamepad, or pressing the ` key.

[+] Added the option to toggle the camera follow distance, by clicking the 'Left Bumper' on gamepad, or pressing the = key.

World Fixes:

[+] Reworked the waterfall environments to reduce the risk of players getting stuck.

[+] Moved / removed various floating objects (please send screenshots if you find any more!)

[+] Adjusted colliders for various objects.

Rover Fixes: 

[+] Reduceed rover friction from 0.4 to 0.2. This should reduce / remove the chance of getting stuck in the ground.

notes.title: ROVA | V0.1.1 Release | Space Exploration Fest Annoucement 📸🪐
notes.content:
Hey all!

The support for ROVA's demo these last few days has been incredible - we can't thank you enough! 

As always, community feedback has played a really important role in ROVA's development. We've just released a patch fixing up a few issues players have encountered, as well as some AI improvements for the colonists. (See Changelog below!)

[h2]Steam Space Exploration Fest[/h2]
As you can see from the big ol' banner shown below, we're taking part in Steam's Space Exploration Fest. It starts today! It's a big moment for us and the game in general, marking our first event! If you would like to help support us further, please consider leaving a review - it helps tell steam to shout louder about us <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971668/5caa9bbf51dc2a3fb444cdd2eb293bfaa76b7233.gif[/img]


[h2][h1]Changelog[/h1][/h2]
World Fixes:

[+] Increased the photo range for the UFO

Input Fixes:

[+] Resolved issues causing the cursor to appear whilst using a controller.

[+] Stopped the cursor from appearing whilst controlling the rover (when using keyboard & mouse)

[+ Stopped the cursor from appearing in 'Observation Mode'

[+] Cursor is now locked to the game window when not visible

Colonist AI Improvements & Fixes:

The fixes to Colonist AI are small, but go a long way in improving how you can harrass them / crash into them.

[+] We've smoothed out colonist movement as they transition to work targets (they no longer teleport!)

[+] Players can now push colonists whilst they're working (some players got stuck next to colonists whilst they worked, but this shouldn't be an issue now!)

[+] Colonists now walk back to their work positions when moved by the player
